title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1987-03-23
lineage: Cassette (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through w/ SBM On) -> SEK'D ProdifPlus -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with a distant, crowd‑heavy mix, yet the performance shines – especially the ripping Althea finale.
ai_review.review: Listeners are split on this 1987 recording: some praise the show’s energy and highlight a wild Althea ending, while others criticize the audio as sounding like a distant audience feed with excessive crowd bleed and missing track information. The source appears to be a soundboard capture, but its mix quality is uneven, making the listening experience mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance receives strong praise (notably Althea), but recording quality is described as distant and poorly labeled, leading to an overall middle‑of‑the‑road rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio sounds distant like audience mic; crowd is very loud; some reviewers suspect a matrix blend. Missing track numbers/labels noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; only the Althea ending is highlighted.
